SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product   p ON p.product_id  = o.product_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.birth_date <= date(o.date, '-25 years') AND c.birth_date >  date(o.date, '-26 years');
